# kintone_app (Data Source)

Reads live app metadata and general settings. A missing app returns an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kintone_app" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

output "app_title_field" {
  value = data.kintone_app.example.title_field
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) App ID as a positive decimal string.

### Read-Only

- `bulk_deletion_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app feature is enabled.
- `code` (String) Published app code.
- `comments_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app feature is enabled.
- `created_at` (String) Published app created_at.
- `creator` (Attributes) App creator. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--creator))
- `description` (String) Published app description.
- `first_month_of_fiscal_year` (Number) First fiscal month, from 1 to 12.
- `inline_record_editing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app feature is enabled.
- `modified_at` (String) Published app modified_at.
- `modifier` (Attributes) App modifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modifier))
- `name` (String) Published app name.
- `number_precision` (Attributes) Number calculation precision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--number_precision))
- `record_duplication_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app feature is enabled.
- `revision` (String) Live settings revision.
- `space_id` (String) Published app space_id.
- `theme` (String) Live settings theme.
- `thread_id` (String) Published app thread_id.
- `thumbnails_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app feature is enabled.
- `title_field` (Attributes) Observed record title selection, including the automatically selected field code in AUTO mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--title_field))
